label: Updated 8 AM ET
title: Today In Golf
summary: A 30-second briefing on today’s biggest golf stories.

items.headline: Rory's Nicklaus Advice
items.text: Jack Nicklaus advised Rory McIlroy to play more cut shots to land softer on greens, helping Rory adapt at Muirfield Village where he seeks his first Memorial win.

items.headline: Korda Leads U.S. Women's Open
items.text: Nelly Korda co-leads the U.S. Women's Open at Riviera, aiming for her second straight major title with Charley Hull three strokes behind.

items.headline: Scheffler's Rule Advantage
items.text: Scottie Scheffler utilized a free drop under Rule 16.1 at the Memorial, moving his ball from a sprinkler head and eagling the par-5 7th hole.
